bundle.shortDescription: Your focus blocks, your projects, and whether they reached Atlas
bundle.longDescription: Keld Signal shows what the local agent collected on this machine: today's focus blocks with their tokens and estimated spend, which project each one landed in, and whether it reached Atlas. The app is a window onto the local agent — it collects nothing itself and holds no credential.
